name: Government forms steering committee on Higher Education

content.text: As Chairman, Dr. Kassim-Lakha will have the status of a Minister of State and will report directly to the President of Pakistan on matters relating to the working of the Committee.

The key functions of the Committee include the development of a plan to restructure the governance and management of public universities and improvement of the operations of universities, their financial management and information systems, as well as the development of systemic linkages with other institutions including industry in the private sector.

The Committee is formed by President Musharraf subsequent to receiving recommendations of the Task Force on the Improvement of Higher Education established by the Ministry of Education and the Study Group on Higher Education in Science and Technology, the report of which had earlier been approved by the government. The Task Force had been co-chaired by Dr. Shamsh Kassim-Lakha and Syed Babar Ali, Pro-Chancellor of the Lahore University of Management Sciences, and had included, amongst other members, the Federal Secretary of Education, the Chairman of the UGC, and eight vice chancellors of public universities and representatives of private universities.

Members of the Steering Committee include Dr. Ishrat Hussain, Governor, State Bank of Pakistan; Dr. Abdul Hafiz Shaikh, Minister for Finance, Government of Sindh; Dr. Zulfiqar Gilani, Vice Chancellor, University of Peshawar; Dr. Mazhar-ul-Haque Siddiqui, Vice Chancellor, University of Sindh; Dr. Najma Najam, Vice Chancellor, Fatima Jinnah Women's University, Rawalpindi; Dr. Tariq Banuri; Prof. Riazuddin, Quaid-e-Azam University; Prof. Iqbal Chaudhry; Dr. Sohail Naqvi, Vice President, Enabling Technologies; Dr. Shaukat Hamid, Director General, Computer Control, PAEC; Dr. Waqar Masood Khan, Additional Secretary, Ministry of Finance; Mr. Ebrahim Sidat, Country Manager Partner, Sidat, Hyder, Qamar & Company, Karachi; and Mr. Salman Akram Raja, Senior Partner, Raja Muhammad Akram & Company, Lahore.

Dr. Shamsh Kassim-Lakha has had a career in higher education and social development spanning four decades. Under the direction of His Highness the Aga Khan, he led the overall planning, construction and now operations of Aga Khan University, chartered in 1983 as Pakistan's first private international university. Aga Khan University, with seven teaching sites on three continents, is an integral component of Aga Khan Development Network.

content.title: Government forms steering committee on Higher Education
content.author: volunteer.pa
content.description: President General Pervez Musharraf has been pleased to appoint Dr. Shamsh Kassim-Lakha, President, Aga Khan University, as Chairman of the Steering Committee on Higher Education.
